theorems.name: Azimuth.sum_replicate
theorems.statement: summing a row k times scales the moment sum by k
theorems.runtime_counterpart: Z_repeat/multiplicity scaling: atomicity means duplicates carry multiplicity
theorems.runtime_predicate: Z_m depends on pattern multiplicities; deduplicated corpora measure distinct patterns only

theorems.name: Azimuth.absSq_scale

nonclaims: nothing about the null distribution of Z_m under the fixed-margin or column-shuffle null
no p-value, tail, multiplicity correction or significance statement
no claim that the corpus has or lacks angular structure
full SO(2) rotation invariance is NOT proved: over Z[i] the gauge group is D4; the Float runtime path is checked by tests, not by this file
no invariance under anisotropic (GL(2)) rescaling of the placement axes: a chart/lens change is outside every statement
the weighted first moment being zero on a centered plane is a modeling fact (PCA scores are mean-centered); unweighted Z_1 measures radial/multiplicity reweighting and is structurally confounded
no claim about document quality, ranking, keep/revert, radius or admission
